Coram : DIPAK MISRA*, V. GOPALA GOWDA
FAMILY COURT ACT, 1984: C s. 7of1984 Act rlw s. 125, CrPC- Duty of Family Court - Explained Application of wife and child remained pending in Family Court for nine years - Family Court granting maintenance to wife and child from the date of order - Held: Both the approaches, i.e., allowing oblivious of objects and reasons of the Act and restricting the grant of maintenance to the date of order on some kind of individual notion, not only defeat the command of the legislature but also frustrate the hope of wife and the child who are deprived of adequate livelihood *"'.7'"
Decision Date : 15-07-2014 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 1331/2014 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
